integrity: The all-n claim has a short algebraic proof from the RSD top-k guarantee, equal treatment of equals, and feasibility. An exact embedded verifier exhausts the n=3 boundary and stress-checks two-type profiles through n=6.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for strict square one-to-one assignment under uniform random priority. It does not cover subjective ties, unequal market sides, nonuniform priorities, or multi-unit assignment.
title: Two preference types restore stochastic-dominance envy-freeness of random priority
